facts.value: tuition fees and essential field trips up to €6,270
You must meet the same conditions as the standard maintenance grant under the Student Grant Scheme for the academic year.
Your total reckonable income in the tax year prior must not be more than €28,600.

You must be getting certain social welfare payments or participating in a designated programme at the end of the year prior, such as long-term social welfare payments, Family Income Supplement, or designated programmes like a Community Employment Scheme.
